description: At the pond, Duck sings quack, snack, back. Robo, Duck and Mouse learn that words rhyme when they sound the same at the end: puzzle halves click together for mouse and house, frog, dog and log, bee and tree, bug and rug, and bump apart for bug and sun. Then odd one out, make a rhyme, a quiz and a rhyme party.

youtube.title: Rhyme Time! Rhyming Words for Preschool | Mouse, House, Frog, Log | Toy Box Friends
youtube.description:
Words rhyme when they sound the same at the end! At the pond, Robo, Duck and Mouse listen to the ends of words. When two words rhyme, their puzzle pieces click together: mouse and house, frog, dog and log, bee and tree, bug and rug. When they don't rhyme, like bug and sun, the pieces bump apart. Kids play odd one out, make a new rhyme (car, jar... star!) and answer a quick rhyme quiz.

Try it at home with a grown-up: put a few toys in a basket (a sock, a block, a toy car, a plastic jar, a hat) and pull out two at a time. Say them slowly: sock, block... rhyme! Then play rhyme fishing: the grown-up says a word and the child says a word that rhymes. Silly words count too! Use a plastic jar and keep small things away from babies.

Made for kids. Toy Box Friends: 3D learning videos for preschool.

do.text: Duck, those words all end the same way.
Let's listen to the ends of words, and find out!
Hi! I'm Mouse. That's my house!
Listen to the end. Mouse... house.
Do they sound the same at the end? Thumbs up, or thumbs down?
Words that sound the same at the end... rhyme.
Mouse, house! Same at the end!
My whiskers help me feel my way in the dark.
Here comes a log. Frog... log!
Click! Frog, dog, log. They all rhyme!
Did you know? Frogs can breathe through their skin!
Bee... tree. Thumbs up, or thumbs down?
Bees visit flowers, to make yummy honey!
Bug... rug. Thumbs up, or thumbs down?
Now... bug... sun. Thumbs up, or thumbs down?
Bug and sun sound different at the end.
Odd one out! Which one does not rhyme?
Ball! Bee and tree rhyme. Ball does not.
Cake! Cake is the odd one out!
What else rhymes with car and jar?
You can make a rhyme, too!
Click! Duck, you're right. They all rhyme!
One. Do bug and rug rhyme?
Two. Do bee and sun rhyme?
Three. Which does not rhyme? Frog, log, ball.
Four. What rhymes with jar? Car, or house?
Same at the end! Quack, back, snack!
